loci.rationale: Marketing audience selection (eligible_campaign/campaign): reads only owner, restricted=0, stage!='abandoned', promotions enabled and objection not enabled; does not read cases.confirmed or cases.income. This is the decisive control for the purpose-limitation predicate.
Promotion delivery in drain: emits a generic offer message with no income-band value, so delivery does not use the partner-confirmed band.
Underwriting use of the band: score job consumes c['confirmed'] or c['income'] to decide offered/declined — the permitted underwriting purpose.
Entrypoint that writes the partner-confirmed band (cases.confirmed) via 'verify', recorded for underwriting only — establishes the data whose downstream use is constrained.
Permitted subscription choices (promotions/objection/insights) stored in choices and used to cancel queued jobs; the lawful marketing inputs.
Promotion job creation path: queues only cid/kind, carries no band parameter, and gates on eligible_campaign.
Human credit decision (review) — the other underwriting use of case data; no marketing consumption of the band.
Schema: cases.confirmed/income columns and jobs(cid,kind) table show the band is stored on the case and jobs carry no targeting payload.

output.path_summary: Partner-confirmed band enters via 'verify' (store.py:0157-0160) into cases.confirmed and is consumed only by the underwriting score job (store.py:0131-0135) and human review (store.py:0191-0196). Marketing selection (eligible_campaign, store.py:0100-0103) draws only on owner, restricted, stage and promotions/objection choices; campaign (0105-0109) and promotion job creation (0165-0171) queue only cid/kind; delivery (0140-0142) emits a generic message with no band. Thus the band is not used for marketing selection or delivery, satisfying the purpose-limitation predicate given the stipulated absence of a compatible purpose or new legal basis.
missing_boundaries: Static reading only; no execution or runtime verification of query results.
Only app.py, store.py, views.py, style.css supplied; no migrations, logs, or external partner fixtures inspected.
Whether a compatible marketing purpose or new legal basis exists is stipulated by the scenario, not verified from code.
views.py:0050 displays the confirmed band on the case detail page to owner and officer; treated as case-file display, not marketing selection/delivery, and outside the named predicate.
No determination on other GDPR obligations (e.g., Art. 6(1) basis for underwriting, Art. 22 automated decisions).
